full_source_reviews.title: Searching for Plans You Can Actually Build: A Realizability-Aware Full-Space Optimizer for MoE Training and Serving
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1; design, implementation, measured positive and negative results, ablations and Appendix measurement calibers reviewed. Artifact release is claimed, but the exact v1 says release URL/license pending, so no public artifact is credited.

locators.artifact: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.18631v1#A1 — exact v1 states that the artifact release URL and license are pending; no public artifact is credited

full_source_reviews.problem: A cost model ranks a superset of plans that the selected compiler, framework and kernels can actually emit, so numerical optimality may nominate an unbuildable plan.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: The search IR spans parallelism, schedule and kernels. A dry-run reuses the code emitter as the realizability predicate, launch probes catch memory/runtime gaps the static predicate misses, and measured realization overhead is priced back into the search rather than represented as a separate rule list.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: Intent and workload enter the planner; the emitter owns buildability truth; cost models own estimates; launch probes and hardware measurements own realized feasibility and performance; preregistered artifacts keep predictions distinct from later measurements.
full_source_reviews.evaluation_and_counterevidence: Two RTX4090 and eight H800 systems cover training and serving. Three of four phase/machine cells pass the paper's 0.98 baseline gate, while H800 training honestly fails at 0.9338. An entirely unbuildable predicted frontier and repeated memory-model falsifications show that realizability is necessary but not sufficient.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Emitter reuse reduces drift but binds search to emitter completeness. Launch probing costs hardware time and still samples a finite environment. Evidence is single-node and small-model relative to frontier deployments; the artifact URL was not released in v1.

benchmark_contract.workload: MoE training and serving plan search
benchmark_contract.model: paper-defined MoE configurations; 2048-GPU case is an oracle/search-only scale
benchmark_contract.evaluator: three-round medians, artifact-hashed preregistration and real launch probes

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Ch56 add a realizability branch before plan ranking: the feasible domain is defined by emitter/launcher capability, not solely by analytical constraints. Preserve cost-model search as useful inside a buildable domain and retain launch-probe fallback because dry-run feasibility does not prove memory/runtime success. Handoff training-specific parallel plans to Ch41 and lowering details to Ch49.
full_source_reviews.source_claim: The exact v1 supports emitter-defined realizability, launch probing, realization-tax calibration, and bounded single-node measurements. It does not prove that dry-run buildability guarantees runtime feasibility or that the reported search quality generalizes to frontier multi-node deployments.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Analytical cost search is reasonable when compiler, framework and kernel capability are stable and modeled constraints describe the executable domain. Once plan space spans phases, hardware and emitters, the optimizer can rank plans the actual toolchain cannot build.

full_source_reviews.title: Stale but Stable: Staleness-Adaptive Trust Regions for Stabilizing Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1 with formal sampled-surrogate geometry, full async training setup, stabilizer grid and limitations; public code URL is present in the manuscript.

locators.artifact: https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/GradLoc; https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/GradLoc/commit/0fdd859a5945a59f3531ded48bc5d6cfd8a15fd5 — event-time repository pointer exists, but this pre-paper commit does not establish that the paper-specific SAT implementation was public

full_source_reviews.problem: A fixed PPO clip radius treats ordinary and highly stale rollout tokens alike in a decoupled asynchronous pipeline, either suppressing useful updates or allowing a heavy mismatch tail to move farther outward.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: SAT derives a detached sampled log-ratio, computes a batch-relative high-tail quantile, and contracts only the sign-selected outward side of PPO's interval. It is a drop-in sampled-surrogate change: the adaptive interval is contained in PPO's, pull-back updates are unchanged, and the objective differs only in the newly clipped outward band.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: Rollout workers own behavior-policy samples; the trainer owns current-policy ratios and clipping; broadcast lag plus implementation differences create realized mismatch. The sampled ratio is a risk proxy, not an estimator of full-vocabulary total variation.
full_source_reviews.evaluation_and_counterevidence: Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base runs on decoupled SGLang/Megatron pools at configured lags 1 and 8, 30,712 prompts, 4,096 responses per iteration and 544 iterations. SAT variants are compared with GRPO/GSPO, R3, TIS and DPPO. Best results require SAT plus R3; plain methods can collapse. One model/task family and finite lag grid do not establish general stability.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Batch quantiles add distribution dependence and may shift with length/domain mixture. Sampled log-ratios can be huge on low-probability actions without large mass movement; sequence ratios can cancel token mismatch. SAT controls the sampled surrogate, not an all-action trust region.

benchmark_contract.hardware: fully decoupled SGLang rollout and Megatron training GPU pools; exact count in Appendix F
benchmark_contract.input_length: training prompts from DAPO-Math-17k and Dolci-RL-Zero-Math-7B
benchmark_contract.concurrency: configured broadcast lag 1 or 8 trainer steps
benchmark_contract.slo: stability and AIME24 performance, not serving SLO

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Ch33 refine asynchronous RL: staleness is heterogeneous within a rollout batch, so scheduler lag alone is insufficient. Add adaptive outward-only clipping as an experimental algorithmic branch, explicitly separating sampled mismatch proxy from full-distribution divergence and preserving bounded-synchrony/on-policy execution when stronger correctness evidence is required.
full_source_reviews.source_claim: The exact v1 supports a sampled log-ratio risk proxy and outward-only, batch-quantile clip contraction in one asynchronous math-RL setup. It does not establish a full-distribution trust-region guarantee, universal stability, or artifact-complete reproducibility.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Fixed PPO/GRPO clipping is reasonable when rollout and update policies remain near each other. Decoupled rollout/training pools create heterogeneous realized mismatch inside one batch, so checkpoint lag alone no longer describes sample risk.

full_source_reviews.title: AgentDebugX: An Open-Source Toolkit for Failure Observability, Attribution, and Recovery in LLM Agents
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1 plus public MIT repository/package links; system pipeline, attribution benchmark, repair rerun and limitations reviewed.
full_source_reviews.problem: A failed agent trajectory exposes many events but does not identify which agent/step first caused the failure or turn diagnosis into a controlled repair.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: Typed trace capture feeds a multi-turn debugger that narrows agent, step and failure class; the diagnosis is converted into a bounded repair and evaluated by a single rerun. Failure taxonomy and framework integrations are extensible surfaces rather than model truth.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: Runtime spans own observed events; the debugger owns a hypothesis and attribution; the repair controller owns whether and how to rerun. Diagnosis must not silently gain production side-effect authority.
full_source_reviews.evaluation_and_counterevidence: Who&When contains 184 traces for localization; GAIA evaluates 73 initially failed tasks for repair. Improvements are shown on tested backbones, but strict exact-step attribution remains low and a successful single rerun does not prove causal diagnosis or robustness across agents.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: More trace detail adds privacy, cost and schema coupling. Debugger errors can misattribute downstream symptoms, and rerun success can arise from stochasticity. Evaluation is narrow and framework instrumentation can change behavior.

benchmark_contract.workload: agent failure localization and one-rerun repair
benchmark_contract.model: tested open-weight debugger backbones including qwen3.5-9b
benchmark_contract.hardware: Not disclosed as a comparative systems variable
benchmark_contract.input_length: trace-dependent; long traces include around 40 events
benchmark_contract.evaluator: strict agent-and-step attribution and task success after rerun

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Ch69 add trace-to-diagnosis-to-repair as a layered contract: trace evidence, causal hypothesis and action authorization are separate states. A successful rerun raises confidence but does not prove attribution; preserve manual/fixed-rule diagnosis for short deterministic workflows and require privacy/redaction plus bounded repair authority.
full_source_reviews.source_claim: The exact v1 and event-time repository support a typed trace-diagnosis-rerun toolkit and bounded evaluations on Who&When and failed GAIA tasks. They do not prove causal attribution, safe autonomous repair, privacy adequacy, or robustness across agent frameworks.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Manual or fixed-rule debugging is reasonable for short deterministic workflows. Multi-turn agents spread the originating fault and downstream symptoms across tool, model and environment spans; a trace alone then cannot safely authorize a repair.

full_source_reviews.title: BaseRT: Advancing Best-in-Class LLM Inference with Apple M5 Neural Accelerators
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1 plus public BaseRT repository; kernel family, workload-aware dispatch, matched-device benchmark and explicit single-device limitations reviewed.
full_source_reviews.problem: A new matrix accelerator changes the profitable execution path for compute-bound prefill without changing the memory-bandwidth ceiling of token-at-a-time decode.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: Metal 4 cooperative-tensor kernels cover dense/MoE GEMM, fused expert projections and prefill attention. Dispatch selects this path only for compute-bound shapes/phases and retains specialized SIMD/GEMV kernels for memory-bound decode or unsupported hardware.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: The runtime owns chip/shape capability and phase dispatch; kernels own layout and numerical equivalence; workload phase determines whether compute or memory is binding.
full_source_reviews.evaluation_and_counterevidence: Fifteen Qwen/Llama/Gemma dense and MoE configurations on one M5 Pro, Q4/Q8, prompt lengths 128-2048 and 128-token decode, five repetitions, compared with pinned llama.cpp and MLX. Prefill gains are large; decode gains are bounded and BaseRT loses narrowly to MLX on two large models.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Hand-written kernels increase maintenance and portability cost. Results are Metal/M5-specific, single-user and single-device; no continuous batching, multi-request decoding or tensor parallelism is tested.

benchmark_contract.evaluator: mean of five repetitions; llama.cpp b9960 and mlx-lm 0.31.3/MLX 0.32.0

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Current Ch49 already owns the durable proposition: accelerator readiness is a phase × shape × offload × host-control contract, phase-aware backend selection must account for tensor/KV handoff, and portable/single-backend fallbacks remain valid. BaseRT is retained as a bounded Apple M5 case, not a new Books mechanism.
full_source_reviews.source_claim: The exact v1 and event-time repository support a phase- and silicon-specific Apple M5 implementation case with pinned single-device comparisons. They do not establish multi-request, multi-device, tail-latency, portability, or general accelerator superiority.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: A single portable backend remains reasonable when portability, maintenance and predictable coverage dominate. Prefill and low-batch decode expose different compute/memory bottlenecks on a particular silicon generation, making phase-specific kernels worthwhile only inside a matched workload contract.

full_source_reviews.title: Where Should Optimizer State Live? Tiered State Allocation for Memory-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Training
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1 plus public SkewAdam repository; formulas, memory accounting, controlled comparisons, tier ablation, learning-rate sweeps and limitations reviewed.
full_source_reviews.problem: Uniform optimizer state treats dense backbone, sparsely activated experts and the tiny router as statistically identical, causing MoE optimizer memory to scale with total parameters rather than active compute.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: SkewAdam keeps momentum plus factored variance for the dense backbone, factored variance without momentum for experts, and exact variance for the router. Parameter role becomes the state-allocation key; this is orthogonal to ZeRO sharding and state quantization.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: Optimizer owns moment representation per parameter class; router statistics remain exact; experts pool row/column second moments; bf16 updates use a shared dithered write-back path across baselines.
full_source_reviews.evaluation_and_counterevidence: A deliberately shallow 6.78B MoE with 128 experts trains for 81.9M tokens from shared initialization. H200 main runs and H100-NVL follow-ups compare AdamW, Lion, Muon, Adafactor and GaLore-style variants. Tier ablation shows memory allocation, not tiers alone, does not explain accuracy; momentum remains important. Weight decay is effectively inert under bf16 rounding.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Role-specific rules increase optimizer complexity and depend on gradient sparsity. Evidence is one architecture/data regime and mostly one seed; the shallow model concentrates expert parameters. Factored estimates may fail where covariance is not approximately separable.

benchmark_contract.model: 6.78B total, about 440M active, two-block decoder with 128 top-2 experts
benchmark_contract.hardware: NVIDIA H200 141GB main; H100 NVL 47GB MIG follow-ups
benchmark_contract.precision: bf16 weights with common dithered rounding; fp32 optimizer statistics as specified
benchmark_contract.slo: memory, throughput, validation perplexity and router balance
benchmark_contract.evaluator: shared initialization/data order; 10,000 steps; tier and LR ablations

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Ch28 add optimizer-state allocation as a model-structure decision: total parameter count need not imply uniform moment state. Preserve full Adam as the clear homogeneous baseline, then explain role-aware state for dense backbone/experts/router and hand off distributed placement/sharding to Ch39. State that single-study convergence does not establish a universal optimizer.
full_source_reviews.source_claim: The exact v1 and event-time repository support role-aware optimizer-state allocation in one deliberately shallow MoE training regime. They do not establish a universal optimizer, large-scale distributed wall-clock gains, or general convergence across architectures and data.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Uniform Adam state is the clearest baseline when parameters have similar update statistics and memory fits. MoE separates dense backbone, sparsely activated experts and sensitive routers, so identical moment state can spend memory on statistics whose value differs by role.

full_source_reviews.title: Supra Cognitive Modes: A Routed Architecture for Agent Memory
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1; routed design, three benchmark protocols, repository-backed diagnostics and unusually explicit evidence limitations reviewed. No public artifact accompanies v1.

locators.artifact: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.19096v1#A2 — exact v1 says release requires later sanitization, licensing and a reproducibility manifest; no public artifact is credited

full_source_reviews.problem: A single memory retrieval procedure cannot simultaneously optimize fact lookup, temporal reconstruction, long-form synthesis and abstention.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: A frozen semantic classifier selects a mode and maps it to a runtime payload over a shared asynchronous substrate. Optional enrichments can be absent; online fallback or omission prevents enrichment from becoming a readiness dependency.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: Classifier owns coarse intent metadata; runtime gates may override it; retrieval and synthesis consume payload flags. The inspected synthesizer does not directly branch on all mode labels, so declared mode and executed procedure are distinct identities.
full_source_reviews.evaluation_and_counterevidence: LoCoMo, LongMemEval and MAB results characterize one implementation. Raw baseline outputs, complete token/cost ledgers, some final routing decisions, held-out procedure labels and significance tests are absent. Stored outputs support diagnostic strata but not causal routing efficiency or superiority.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Routing adds classifier error, override drift and provenance requirements. Hard-coded paths limit portability; benchmark contamination and judge dependence remain. A fixed simple retrieval path is preferable for homogeneous tasks or weak routing evidence.

benchmark_contract.workload: long-term agent-memory QA across LoCoMo, LongMemEval and MAB
benchmark_contract.hardware: not disclosed as a controlled systems variable
benchmark_contract.batch: repository-backed stored runs; two repetitions only for selected MAB result
benchmark_contract.concurrency: asynchronous substrate but no comparative concurrency experiment
benchmark_contract.evaluator: benchmark judges and repository-backed diagnostic joins; no significance tests

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Ch77 already carries routing, derived-state provenance, asynchronous enrichment, abstention and evidence-boundary contracts. Retain this family in review notes as an experimental case; do not add a named architecture or benchmark claims until public artifact and causal route evidence exist.
full_source_reviews.source_claim: The exact v1 supports one routed memory architecture and benchmark-specific diagnostic results. It does not establish causal benefit from routing, portable timing/cost gains, statistically robust superiority, or public-artifact reproducibility.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: A fixed retrieval path is reasonable for homogeneous tasks and weak routing evidence. Heterogeneous memory questions may benefit from procedure selection, but declared mode, runtime override and actually executed procedure must remain distinct identities.

full_source_reviews.title: Integrity of peer-to-peer distributed LLM inference under malicious nodes
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1 with formal threat model, preregistered factorial, ablations, breaking-point studies and explicit limitations; no public implementation artifact located.

locators.artifact: Not Disclosed — exact v1 provides no public repository, code release, or immutable artifact locator

full_source_reviews.problem: A peer-to-peer pipeline delegates intermediate layers to untrusted nodes; final-output checks cannot localize silent activation tampering without redundant recomputation.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: The verifier interleaves indistinguishable known-answer canaries, stores clean fp32 intermediate activations, measures per-shard relative-L2 mismatch against live fp16 activations and ranks shards by per-canary AUROC rather than relying on one universal threshold.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: The verifier owns canary identity and reference activations; peers own untrusted stage execution; mismatch evidence identifies suspect shards but does not itself authorize eviction or prove intent.
full_source_reviews.evaluation_and_counterevidence: 408 simulated configurations use GPT-2/Pythia-160M and a depth substudy with Pythia-410M, 100 canaries, multiple attacks, positions, colluders and noise levels. Detection is perfect at the modeled low-noise floor, but degrades toward chance as benign noise meets/exceeds tamper magnitude. Cosine distance fails on magnitude-only rescaling.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: References require trusted precomputation and activation storage. Real heterogeneous nondeterminism is not isotropic Gaussian; models are small. Adaptive attackers can fingerprint canaries or tune below the measured floor, and persistent-on-every-query attacks are easier than selective attacks.

benchmark_contract.workload: integrity auditing of pipeline-parallel peer-to-peer inference
benchmark_contract.model: GPT-2 124M, Pythia-160M; Pythia-410M only in depth study
benchmark_contract.hardware: simulated fp16 live stages against fp32 references; live heterogeneous pool not tested
benchmark_contract.precision: fp32 reference, fp16 live pass with modeled noise
benchmark_contract.evaluator: relative-L2 per-canary AUROC, controls and harm frontier

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Ch72 add intermediate-state integrity as a challenge-response branch: final output correctness cannot localize an untrusted stage. Known-answer canaries can create comparative evidence when reference state and noise envelope are controlled, but must coexist with attestation/redundancy because adaptive canary detection and heterogeneous numeric noise remain unresolved.
full_source_reviews.source_claim: The exact v1 supports relative-L2 known-answer canaries as comparative integrity evidence in 408 simulated configurations. It does not establish production P2P integrity, heterogeneous-noise calibration, adaptive-attacker resistance, or authorization to evict a peer.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Artifact signatures and final-output checks are reasonable when execution stays inside trusted infrastructure. Pipeline-parallel inference across untrusted peers needs evidence at intermediate state boundaries because a wrong final token cannot localize the stage that corrupted it.

closure_reviews.title: MoA-Structured Decode Attention DNF Derivation, KV-Cache Accumulation, GQA/MQA, and OpenACC Kernel

locators.artifact: Not Disclosed — exact v1 provides no public repository or measured GPU kernel artifact

closure_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1 derivation, CPU numerical-equivalence checks, analytical traffic accounting and stated limitations reviewed; no measured GPU execution, production kernel comparison or public artifact was disclosed.
closure_reviews.mechanism: The paper rewrites conventional single-query decode attention, KV append and GQA/MQA selection in MoA/DNF notation and sketches an OpenACC kernel.
closure_reviews.source_claim: The exact v1 supports algebraic equivalence, CPU numerical checks and analytical traffic accounting. It does not demonstrate a new deployed execution mechanism, measured GPU speedup, production correctness, or public artifact.
closure_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Conventional decode attention, preallocated KV append and GQA/MQA head mapping already express the same state transition; the new notation does not change ownership or control flow.
closure_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: The reformulation may aid one implementation style but adds notation and compiler dependence without measured accelerator evidence; the established attention/KV execution path remains the verified baseline.
closure_reviews.closure_reason: Existing attention, KV-cache and execution-plan chapters already own these invariants. Exact v1 adds no demonstrated GPU mechanism or long-term design delta.

books_serialization_queue.target_ref: books/part-05-inference-system/56-inference-scheduling.md — 从逐配置压测到校准后的配置搜索
books_serialization_queue.insert_after: ## 从逐配置压测到校准后的配置搜索
books_serialization_queue.heading: ### 先冻结可实现域，再排序候选计划
books_serialization_queue.patch_text: 分析模型先枚举配置、再预测成本，在编译器、框架和 kernel 能力稳定时是合理的：搜索器可以把硬件时间留给少量候选。但当计划同时跨越 parallelism、schedule、kernel 与训练/推理 phase 时，满足显式 memory 或 topology 约束，不再等于当前工具链真的能生成并启动该计划。此时搜索必须先定义一个由 emitter 拥有的可实现域：复用正式 code emitter 做 dry-run，记录 buildability 与拒绝原因；再对候选做 launch probe，验证 static check 看不到的 allocator、runtime 与 memory failure；最后把 measured realization tax 回写 cost model，才在可实现域中排序。这样获得的是更少的不可执行“最优解”，代价是 search 与 emitter version 耦合、launch probe 占用真实硬件，且有限探测仍不能证明生产期可行。新硬件、新 kernel、强 tail-SLO 或跨节点通信尚未校准时，targeted profiling 与保守固定 plan 仍不可替代。训练侧 parallel plan 交给 Ch41，lowering 合法性交给 Ch49；本章只拥有 fleet-level 候选 admission 与 ranking。
books_serialization_queue.review_notes:
- Searching for Plans You Can Actually Build（exact v1；Status: Experimental）：https://arxiv.org/html/2607.18631v1
  - 证据边界：2×RTX4090 与 8×H800 单节点；四个 phase/hardware cell 中 H800 training 未通过作者 0.98 gate；v1 未给公开 artifact URL。

books_serialization_queue.target_ref: books/part-04-training-system/33-grpo.md — 从允许异步到用算法不变量约束异步
books_serialization_queue.insert_after: ### 从“允许异步”到“用算法不变量约束异步”
books_serialization_queue.heading: #### Staleness 还可以成为 Objective-level Actuator
books_serialization_queue.patch_text: Trajectory lifecycle gate 只能决定样本能否进入 buffer，不能说明已接纳样本在 objective 中应该获得同样大的更新权限。固定 PPO/GRPO clipping 在 rollout 与 current policy 始终接近时最清楚；异步 rollout/training 分池后，同一 batch 内样本的 realized mismatch 可能高度异质，单一 checkpoint lag 无法表达低概率 action 上的风险。一个实验性分支是对每个 sampled token 计算 current/behavior log-ratio，以 batch 高尾分位数形成 staleness proxy，再只向内收缩 PPO 原有的外侧 clip 边界：匹配较好的样本沿用原 contract，风险较高的样本不能获得更宽的更新区间。这里的关系是 Alternative Branch，而不是替代 lifecycle admission。它用样本级风险响应换取 quantile 对 domain/length mixture 的依赖；sampled ratio 也不是全 vocabulary divergence 或严格 trust region 的证明，token mismatch 还可能在 sequence ratio 中抵消。proxy 未校准、严格 on-policy 或 correctness 证据优先时，同步或有界 staleness 仍更可靠。
books_serialization_queue.review_notes:
- Stale but Stable / SAT（exact v1；Status: Experimental）：https://arxiv.org/html/2607.18722v1
  - 证据边界：Qwen3-30B-A3B 数学 RL、30,712 prompts、4096 responses/iteration、544 iterations、lag 1/8；event-time GradLoc repo commit 早于论文，不能证明 SAT artifact 已公开。

books_serialization_queue.target_ref: books/part-06-ai-infrastructure/69-trace.md — 从 Linear Trace 到 Root-cause Graph
books_serialization_queue.insert_after: ## 从 Linear Trace 到 Root-cause Graph
books_serialization_queue.heading: ### 从 Root-cause Hypothesis 到受限 Repair
books_serialization_queue.patch_text: Root-cause graph 缩小调查范围后，还不能把诊断直接提升为修改生产行为的权威。多轮 Agent 的下游症状可能由上游 tool error、环境漂移或模型判断共同造成，因此应把四类状态分开版本化：trace evidence 记录实际发生的 span 与 artifact；diagnoser 只提交带依据的 causal hypothesis；repair controller 根据 side-effect class、权限和回滚条件决定是否允许 patch/rerun；rerun result 再成为新的 evidence。一次 rerun 成功会提高该修复路径的实用置信度，却可能来自随机采样或环境恢复，不能反向证明原 attribution 必然正确。这个分层获得可审计的 recovery loop，也新增 trace 隐私、schema coupling、诊断误归因和 repair authority 风险。短、确定、规则清晰的 workflow 仍适合人工或固定规则诊断；高副作用动作必须要求人工批准、独立 regression evidence 或 abstain。
books_serialization_queue.review_notes:
- AgentDebugX（exact v1 + event-time commit；Status: Experimental）：https://arxiv.org/html/2607.18754v1
  - 证据边界：184 localization traces、73 个 initially failed GAIA tasks；strict exact-step attribution 仍低，一次 rerun 不能证明因果归因或跨框架安全性。

books_serialization_queue.target_ref: books/part-04-training-system/28-pretraining.md — Optimizer 不是与参数化无关的旋钮
books_serialization_queue.insert_after: ## Optimizer 不是与参数化无关的旋钮
books_serialization_queue.heading: ### Optimizer State Allocation 也应服从参数角色
books_serialization_queue.patch_text: Uniform Adam 为每个参数维护同构的一阶、二阶状态，语义清楚、kernel 成熟，在参数统计相近且 memory 可接受时仍是基线。MoE 改变的是参数角色与 activation frequency：dense backbone 持续更新，experts 稀疏且按 routing 命中，router 参数少却直接控制流量。因而一个实验性分支是按角色分配 optimizer state：backbone 保留 momentum 与 factored variance，experts 只保留 factored variance，router 保留更精确统计；共同的 write-back/rounding contract 仍需一致。它把 optimizer memory 从总参数数目的固定倍数改成结构感知预算，却新增 parameter-group policy、factorization bias、checkpoint migration 和对 gradient sparsity 的依赖。它与 ZeRO/offload 是正交关系：本章决定保存哪些统计，Ch39 决定这些统计物理放在哪里。现有证据来自单个浅层 MoE、短训练与大多单 seed，不能写成 universal optimizer；结构均匀、factored covariance 假设不成立或恢复简单性优先时，完整 Adam 仍更合理。
books_serialization_queue.review_notes:
- SkewAdam / Tiered Optimizer State（exact v1 + event-time commit；Status: Experimental）：https://arxiv.org/html/2607.19058v1
  - 证据边界：6.78B total / 440M active、128 experts、约 81.9M tokens，H200 为主且有 H100/MI300X follow-up；不证明大规模 distributed wall-clock 或普遍收敛。

books_serialization_queue.insert_after: probabilistic service-integrity attestation paragraph, before ## 从 Trace 检查到受限状态空间验证
books_serialization_queue.heading: ### Intermediate-state Canary 是 Integrity Sensor，不是 Eviction Authority
books_serialization_queue.patch_text: Artifact 签名和 final-output check 能证明加载对象或发现最终错误，却不能在不可信 pipeline stage 之间定位哪一段改写了状态。一个 challenge-response 分支是由 verifier 持有 versioned canary 与受信 reference activation，在 live fp16 执行时比较每个 shard 的 intermediate state，并按校准 noise envelope 输出 suspect evidence。这样把完整性观测推进到状态边界，但 detector 仍只是 sensor：它不能独自证明恶意意图，也不能越权驱逐 peer；eviction、retry 或冗余执行仍由 policy gate、attestation 与 failure budget 决定。reference 预计算与保存增加存储和版本成本，真实异构 nondeterminism 未必服从模拟噪声，adaptive attacker 还可能识别 canary 或将扰动压到检测阈值下。稳定可信集群中，端到端校验可能更便宜；不可信协作环境则需要 canary、redundancy、attestation 与抽样审计共存。
books_serialization_queue.review_notes:
- Integrity of peer-to-peer distributed LLM inference（exact v1；Status: Experimental）：https://arxiv.org/html/2607.19490v1
  - 证据边界：GPT-2/Pythia 小模型、408 个模拟配置、fp32 reference 对 fp16 live path 与 modeled Gaussian noise；低噪声 AUROC 不能外推 live heterogeneous pool 或 adaptive attacker。

deep_analysis_units.narrative: 旧式配置搜索先假设候选计划属于同一个可执行域，再用 analytical cost 排序；在工具链稳定时这很合理。MoE training/serving 把 parallelism、schedule、kernel 与 phase 同时纳入搜索后，约束变成 emitter、framework 与 device 共同决定的 buildability。新的控制链是 emitter dry-run 定义可构建域、launch probe 验证运行可行性、realized tax 回写搜索。收益是避免把不可构建计划当成最优，代价是搜索与 emitter 版本耦合、探测占用硬件且仍可能漏掉生产 failure mode；未校准硬件或强 tail-SLO 下仍需 targeted profiling。

固定 clipping 假设 rollout 与 update policy 的偏差处于可接受范围；同步或低 lag 时它足够简单。异步池化让同一 batch 内样本具有不同 realized mismatch，checkpoint lag 不再是完整风险量。SAT 用 sampled log-ratio 形成代理量，再以 batch high-tail quantile 只向内收缩 PPO 的外侧 clip 边界。它获得一条与样本风险相关的 objective actuator，却新增 quantile/domain dependence，并且 sampled ratio 不是全动作分布的 trust-region 证明；严格 on-policy 或 proxy 未校准时，同步/有界 staleness 仍更容易验证。

签名与 final-output check 在可信执行域内足以证明 artifact identity 或发现结果错误；跨不可信 peer 的 pipeline 把故障定位压力推进到 intermediate activation。known-answer canary 用受信 fp32 reference 与 live fp16 shard output 的 relative-L2 形成比较证据，再由 verifier 归因 suspect stage。它换取局部审计能力，却依赖受信 reference、noise envelope 与 canary secrecy；模拟低噪声 AUROC 不能外推真实异构 nondeterminism，adaptive attacker、选择性攻击与 eviction authorization 仍需 attestation、redundancy 与 policy gate 共同承担。

2607.18631.title: Searching for Plans You Can Actually Build: A Realizability-Aware Full-Space Optimizer for MoE Training and Serving
2607.18631.artifact: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.18631v1#A1 — exact v1 states that the artifact release URL and license are pending; no public artifact is credited
2607.18631.delta: The search IR spans parallelism, schedule and kernels. A dry-run reuses the code emitter as the realizability predicate, launch probes catch memory/runtime gaps the static predicate misses, and measured realization overhead is priced back into the search rather than represented as a separate rule list.
2607.18631.source_claim: The exact v1 supports emitter-defined realizability, launch probing, realization-tax calibration, and bounded single-node measurements. It does not prove that dry-run buildability guarantees runtime feasibility or that the reported search quality generalizes to frontier multi-node deployments.
2607.18631.analysis_old: Analytical cost search is reasonable when compiler, framework and kernel capability are stable and modeled constraints describe the executable domain. Once plan space spans phases, hardware and emitters, the optimizer can rank plans the actual toolchain cannot build.
2607.18631.analysis_tradeoff: Emitter reuse reduces drift but binds search to emitter completeness. Launch probing costs hardware time and still samples a finite environment. Evidence is single-node and small-model relative to frontier deployments; the artifact URL was not released in v1.

benchmark.workload: MoE training and serving plan search
benchmark.model: paper-defined MoE configurations; 2048-GPU case is an oracle/search-only scale
benchmark.evaluator: three-round medians, artifact-hashed preregistration and real launch probes

2607.18722.title: Stale but Stable: Staleness-Adaptive Trust Regions for Stabilizing Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning
2607.18722.artifact: https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/GradLoc; https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/GradLoc/commit/0fdd859a5945a59f3531ded48bc5d6cfd8a15fd5 — event-time repository pointer exists, but this pre-paper commit does not establish that the paper-specific SAT implementation was public
2607.18722.delta: SAT derives a detached sampled log-ratio, computes a batch-relative high-tail quantile, and contracts only the sign-selected outward side of PPO's interval. It is a drop-in sampled-surrogate change: the adaptive interval is contained in PPO's, pull-back updates are unchanged, and the objective differs only in the newly clipped outward band.
2607.18722.source_claim: The exact v1 supports a sampled log-ratio risk proxy and outward-only, batch-quantile clip contraction in one asynchronous math-RL setup. It does not establish a full-distribution trust-region guarantee, universal stability, or artifact-complete reproducibility.
2607.18722.analysis_old: Fixed PPO/GRPO clipping is reasonable when rollout and update policies remain near each other. Decoupled rollout/training pools create heterogeneous realized mismatch inside one batch, so checkpoint lag alone no longer describes sample risk.
2607.18722.analysis_tradeoff: Batch quantiles add distribution dependence and may shift with length/domain mixture. Sampled log-ratios can be huge on low-probability actions without large mass movement; sequence ratios can cancel token mismatch. SAT controls the sampled surrogate, not an all-action trust region.

benchmark.hardware: fully decoupled SGLang rollout and Megatron training GPU pools; exact count in Appendix F
benchmark.input_length: training prompts from DAPO-Math-17k and Dolci-RL-Zero-Math-7B
benchmark.concurrency: configured broadcast lag 1 or 8 trainer steps
benchmark.slo: stability and AIME24 performance, not serving SLO

2607.18754.title: AgentDebugX: An Open-Source Toolkit for Failure Observability, Attribution, and Recovery in LLM Agents
2607.18754.delta: Typed trace capture feeds a multi-turn debugger that narrows agent, step and failure class; the diagnosis is converted into a bounded repair and evaluated by a single rerun. Failure taxonomy and framework integrations are extensible surfaces rather than model truth.
2607.18754.source_claim: The exact v1 and event-time repository support a typed trace-diagnosis-rerun toolkit and bounded evaluations on Who&When and failed GAIA tasks. They do not prove causal attribution, safe autonomous repair, privacy adequacy, or robustness across agent frameworks.
2607.18754.analysis_old: Manual or fixed-rule debugging is reasonable for short deterministic workflows. Multi-turn agents spread the originating fault and downstream symptoms across tool, model and environment spans; a trace alone then cannot safely authorize a repair.
2607.18754.analysis_tradeoff: More trace detail adds privacy, cost and schema coupling. Debugger errors can misattribute downstream symptoms, and rerun success can arise from stochasticity. Evaluation is narrow and framework instrumentation can change behavior.

benchmark.workload: agent failure localization and one-rerun repair
benchmark.model: tested open-weight debugger backbones including qwen3.5-9b
benchmark.hardware: Not disclosed as a comparative systems variable
benchmark.input_length: trace-dependent; long traces include around 40 events
benchmark.evaluator: strict agent-and-step attribution and task success after rerun

2607.19438.title: BaseRT: Advancing Best-in-Class LLM Inference with Apple M5 Neural Accelerators
2607.19438.delta: Metal 4 cooperative-tensor kernels cover dense/MoE GEMM, fused expert projections and prefill attention. Dispatch selects this path only for compute-bound shapes/phases and retains specialized SIMD/GEMV kernels for memory-bound decode or unsupported hardware.
2607.19438.source_claim: The exact v1 and event-time repository support a phase- and silicon-specific Apple M5 implementation case with pinned single-device comparisons. They do not establish multi-request, multi-device, tail-latency, portability, or general accelerator superiority.
2607.19438.analysis_old: A single portable backend remains reasonable when portability, maintenance and predictable coverage dominate. Prefill and low-batch decode expose different compute/memory bottlenecks on a particular silicon generation, making phase-specific kernels worthwhile only inside a matched workload contract.
2607.19438.analysis_tradeoff: Hand-written kernels increase maintenance and portability cost. Results are Metal/M5-specific, single-user and single-device; no continuous batching, multi-request decoding or tensor parallelism is tested.

benchmark.evaluator: mean of five repetitions; llama.cpp b9960 and mlx-lm 0.31.3/MLX 0.32.0

2607.19058.title: Where Should Optimizer State Live? Tiered State Allocation for Memory-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Training
2607.19058.delta: SkewAdam keeps momentum plus factored variance for the dense backbone, factored variance without momentum for experts, and exact variance for the router. Parameter role becomes the state-allocation key; this is orthogonal to ZeRO sharding and state quantization.
2607.19058.source_claim: The exact v1 and event-time repository support role-aware optimizer-state allocation in one deliberately shallow MoE training regime. They do not establish a universal optimizer, large-scale distributed wall-clock gains, or general convergence across architectures and data.
2607.19058.analysis_old: Uniform Adam state is the clearest baseline when parameters have similar update statistics and memory fits. MoE separates dense backbone, sparsely activated experts and sensitive routers, so identical moment state can spend memory on statistics whose value differs by role.
2607.19058.analysis_tradeoff: Role-specific rules increase optimizer complexity and depend on gradient sparsity. Evidence is one architecture/data regime and mostly one seed; the shallow model concentrates expert parameters. Factored estimates may fail where covariance is not approximately separable.

benchmark.model: 6.78B total, about 440M active, two-block decoder with 128 top-2 experts
benchmark.hardware: NVIDIA H200 141GB main; H100 NVL 47GB MIG follow-ups
benchmark.precision: bf16 weights with common dithered rounding; fp32 optimizer statistics as specified
benchmark.slo: memory, throughput, validation perplexity and router balance
benchmark.evaluator: shared initialization/data order; 10,000 steps; tier and LR ablations

2607.19096.title: Supra Cognitive Modes: A Routed Architecture for Agent Memory
2607.19096.artifact: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.19096v1#A2 — exact v1 says release requires later sanitization, licensing and a reproducibility manifest; no public artifact is credited
2607.19096.delta: A frozen semantic classifier selects a mode and maps it to a runtime payload over a shared asynchronous substrate. Optional enrichments can be absent; online fallback or omission prevents enrichment from becoming a readiness dependency.
2607.19096.source_claim: The exact v1 supports one routed memory architecture and benchmark-specific diagnostic results. It does not establish causal benefit from routing, portable timing/cost gains, statistically robust superiority, or public-artifact reproducibility.
2607.19096.analysis_old: A fixed retrieval path is reasonable for homogeneous tasks and weak routing evidence. Heterogeneous memory questions may benefit from procedure selection, but declared mode, runtime override and actually executed procedure must remain distinct identities.
2607.19096.analysis_tradeoff: Routing adds classifier error, override drift and provenance requirements. Hard-coded paths limit portability; benchmark contamination and judge dependence remain. A fixed simple retrieval path is preferable for homogeneous tasks or weak routing evidence.

benchmark.hardware: not disclosed as a controlled systems variable
benchmark.batch: repository-backed stored runs; two repetitions only for selected MAB result
benchmark.concurrency: asynchronous substrate but no comparative concurrency experiment
benchmark.evaluator: benchmark judges and repository-backed diagnostic joins; no significance tests

2607.19490.title: Integrity of peer-to-peer distributed LLM inference under malicious nodes
2607.19490.artifact: Not Disclosed — exact v1 provides no public repository, code release, or immutable artifact locator
2607.19490.delta: The verifier interleaves indistinguishable known-answer canaries, stores clean fp32 intermediate activations, measures per-shard relative-L2 mismatch against live fp16 activations and ranks shards by per-canary AUROC rather than relying on one universal threshold.
2607.19490.source_claim: The exact v1 supports relative-L2 known-answer canaries as comparative integrity evidence in 408 simulated configurations. It does not establish production P2P integrity, heterogeneous-noise calibration, adaptive-attacker resistance, or authorization to evict a peer.
2607.19490.analysis_old: Artifact signatures and final-output checks are reasonable when execution stays inside trusted infrastructure. Pipeline-parallel inference across untrusted peers needs evidence at intermediate state boundaries because a wrong final token cannot localize the stage that corrupted it.
2607.19490.analysis_tradeoff: References require trusted precomputation and activation storage. Real heterogeneous nondeterminism is not isotropic Gaussian; models are small. Adaptive attackers can fingerprint canaries or tune below the measured floor, and persistent-on-every-query attacks are easier than selective attacks.

benchmark.workload: integrity auditing of pipeline-parallel peer-to-peer inference
benchmark.model: GPT-2 124M, Pythia-160M; Pythia-410M only in depth study
benchmark.hardware: simulated fp16 live stages against fp32 references; live heterogeneous pool not tested
benchmark.precision: fp32 reference, fp16 live pass with modeled noise
benchmark.evaluator: relative-L2 per-canary AUROC, controls and harm frontier

2607.19456.title: MoA-Structured Decode Attention DNF Derivation, KV-Cache Accumulation, GQA/MQA, and OpenACC Kernel
2607.19456.artifact: Not Disclosed — exact v1 provides no public repository or measured GPU kernel artifact
2607.19456.delta: The paper rewrites conventional single-query decode attention, KV append and GQA/MQA selection in MoA/DNF notation and sketches an OpenACC kernel.
2607.19456.source_claim: The exact v1 supports algebraic equivalence, CPU numerical checks and analytical traffic accounting. It does not demonstrate a new deployed execution mechanism, measured GPU speedup, production correctness, or public artifact.
2607.19456.analysis_old: Conventional decode attention, preallocated KV append and GQA/MQA head mapping already express the same state transition; the new notation does not change ownership or control flow.
2607.19456.analysis_tradeoff: The reformulation may aid one implementation style but adds notation and compiler dependence without measured accelerator evidence; the established attention/KV execution path remains the verified baseline.
